missing_value_policy: No zero-fill. A training or scoring row is invalid if any frozen reduced-contract feature is absent or non-numeric.
projection_rule: Project only these 12 numeric paths from a payload already valid under the frozen full V7 combined feature contract. Extra full-contract features are discarded from the projected scoring payload.
notes: This freezes model input identity only; it does not establish historical source readiness.
Candidate fitting remains blocked until all source-readiness attestations verify against durable evidence.
Changing this feature set requires a new contract version and new evidence.
